noah: Huge shoutout to @infra-team and @olivia for rescuing the demo network hiccup this morning — client demo went off without a hitch. :tada: Coffee + boba on me (well, on the snack fund).

lina: omg thank you for the heads up — team rallied fast. extra appreciation for the late-night triage. :heart: 

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: canary -> prod (rollback fix applied) — logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/abcd1234 

matt: And special props to Sam for the quick shell script that rotated the certs. Saved us 15 mins. 

sam: hah, just trying to keep the plants watered too. :seedling: Glad it helped. snippet: ```./rotate-certs.sh --force``` 

cara: Vote: do we want a small snack run tomorrow for the on-call champs? :popcorn: React :thumbsup: for yes, :thinking: for later. 

noah: +1 yes please. Also, anyone want to claim me as boba sponsor? I'll bring matcha. 

olivia: Not a bad idea. I'll add a 'thanks' note to the wiki so we remember the fix steps. Also linking the playbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/playbooks/network-troubleshooting 

lina: Can we add Sam's cert-rotate snippet to the playbook too? Saved the day. 

sam: sure — i'll paste in a cleaned version after lunch. :slightly_smiling_face:
